host.description: Hostname or IP address of the SSH server

private_key.description: Private key (RSA, ECDSA or Ed25519) in OpenSSH, PEM (PKCS#1/SEC1) or PKCS#8 format, including the BEGIN/END lines

passphrase.description: Passphrase of the private key, if it is encrypted

password.description: Password, used when no private key is given

host_key_fingerprint.description: Expected SHA256 fingerprint of the server's host key, as printed by `ssh-keygen -lf` (e.g. SHA256:abc...). Separate several fingerprints with commas when the actions target several hosts. Required unless accept_unknown_host_keys is enabled; if it is missing, the action fails and its error shows the server's fingerprint.

accept_unknown_host_keys.description: Accept any host key when no fingerprint is set. Insecure: an attacker able to intercept the connection could impersonate the server. Use only for testing.

allowed_hosts.description: Other hosts the actions may target through their host argument. Overrides to hosts outside this list (and the account's host) are refused.

description: Run commands and scripts on remote hosts over SSH. Designed to be executed on-premises with a playbook runner.
name: SSH Remote Execution
